LanguageData.OARK_TalkWithProspectingLeader: During a brief conversation with {0}, you learn that this is a prospecting team dispatched by the Oberonia Aurea Foreign Affairs Department for field exploration. They have completed their mission, but heavy equipment has significantly slowed their progress and caused considerable additional physical exhaustion. They are currently looking for a place to rest briefly.\n\nThey haven't made a formal request, but their condition clearly requires a resting camp. You can actively invite them to visit your colony or politely decline their needs, which won't have any significant impact.
LanguageData.OARK_ProspectingLeader_Serve: Invite them to rest at the colony
